The graph of the function $f(x),$ which is defined on $[-5,4],$ is shown above. The areas of the regions between the graph and the $x$-axis are $5$, $7$ and $3,$ respectively (from left to right). Find the average value of $f(x)$ on $[-5,4].$
question.worked_solution:
The average value of a function on a given interval is

$$
{f}_{\text{avg}}=\frac{1}{b-a}{\int }_{a}^{b}f(x)\,\text{d}x.
$$

Here, we see that

$$
{\int }_{-5}^{4}f(x)\,\text{d}x=-5+7-3=-1.
$$

So, applying the average value formula, we find that the average value is

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}_{\text{avg}} & =\frac{1}{b-a}{\int }_{a}^{b}f(x)\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{4-(-5)}\cdot (-1) \\  & =-\frac{1}{9}.\end{aligned}
$$
